resources.string: Android App Link domains are discovered automatically when available; you can also add domains such as github.com manually. A domain becomes persistent when you add it or create a dedicated rule/order. Removing a configured domain also removes its dedicated rules and ordering.
Enter a valid host such as github.com.
Current ordering source: inherited from Deep links · All

Without dedicated ordering, this domain inherits Deep links · All directly. The first select, deselect, drag, or move operation creates dedicated ordering from the inherited order. Restoring inheritance follows future Deep links · All changes again.
